director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket pitch jaisi number line par fractions dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Aaj hum fractions ko ek seedhi line par jagah denge. Cricket ki pitch socho. Ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman run lene bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, toh us jagah ka bhi ek number hai.
haan samajh gayi
Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Upar theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh upar line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Achha, ise ek baar aise sochte hain. Ghar 0 par hai, chai ki dukaan 1 km par. Upar ki line par sadak 7 barabar gaps mein bati hai. Khilona pehle mark par ruk gaya. Woh sadak ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, aur us jagah ka number hai 1/7 kilometre. Yahan tak saaf hai?
thoda hindi mein samjhao

Bilkul, ab yeh Hindi mein bolti hoon. Khilona hawa mein nahi, sadak ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai. Us jagah ka bhi number hai, 1/7 kilometre. Neeche ki line par sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Neeche ki line par sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1 and 6

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Neeche ki line bhi wahi sadak hai, bas 6 barabar gaps mein. Ek gap poore kilometre ka kaunsa fraction hai, yahi socho. Neeche ki line par sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Neeche ki line par sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: one sixth km
Haan, sahi hai, kyunki neeche ki line ki sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla mark 0 se ek gap par, yaani 1/6 kilometre. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yeh lo, isi cheez ki ek aur tasveer, ise dhyan se dekho. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3
Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Is sawaal ka sahi jawab: isi line par, kyunki neeche ka 3 matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps, aur pehla gap isi line par khatam hota hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
pata nahi, aap batao
1/3 poore 1 se chhota hai, toh woh 0 aur 1 ke beech hi aata hai, 3 ke paas kabhi nahi. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
mujhe nahi pata

Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab upar ki line par 6 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/7. Ab neeche ki line dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Neeche ki line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Ab neeche ki line dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Neeche ki line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Ab neeche ki line dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Neeche ki line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: 7 sahi nahi hai. Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Darzi ka ribbon socho, 0 se 1 metre. Upar ki line par 6 chalk ke marks hain, aur ribbon ke 7 barabar gap. Pehla mark pehle gap ke end par hai, yaani 1/7 metre. Naam gap ginkar milta hai, marks ginkar nahi. Ab tak samajh aaya?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara
Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh number line wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Ribbon par neeche ki line mein pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par hai. Neeche ki line mein kitne chalk ke marks hain?
director.card: Ribbon par neeche ki line mein pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par hai. Neeche ki line mein kitne chalk ke marks hain?

director.text: 12 nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Neeche ki line par ribbon ke gap socho: marks gap ke beech hote hain, isliye marks hamesha gap se ek kam. Pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par ho, toh ribbon par neeche ki line mein kitne chalk ke marks hain?
director.card: Ribbon par neeche ki line mein pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par hai. Neeche ki line mein kitne chalk ke marks hain?

director.text: pata nahi
Is sawaal ka jawab 11 hai, kyunki 1/12 metre matlab ribbon ke 12 barabar gap, aur 12 gap ke beech 11 marks hote hain. Cricket mein tumhe kya karna sabse achha lagta hai?
bowling karna

Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai bowling karna. Ab wapas apne kaam par aate hain. Ab neeche ki line dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Neeche ki line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Ab neeche ki line dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Neeche ki line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai bowling karna.

director.text: 8 barabar gaps

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par upar ki line par 8 barabar gaps hain. 7 gaps se zyada gaps, toh har ek chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8, bilkul 0 se chipka hua. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan, samajh aaya
Neeche ki line par wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Neeche ki line par wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: ek bata das

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par khade hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre door hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Pehla kadam dekho. Ek line kheencho, ghar 0 par aur school 1 par: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki ghar se school tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yeh kadam samajh aaya?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe mat gino, unke beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe hain, toh ginti 4 aayi, kyunki beech mein jitne marks hon, gaps hamesha usse ek zyada.
haan samajh gayi
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1/4 km

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 kilometre ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai. Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1/10 sahi nahi hai. Marks chhodo, gaps gino. 0 se 1 ki line par 10 marks se jitne gaps bane, wahi neeche wala number hai. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1/11 hai na

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 10 marks se line ke 11 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/11. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai, kyunki 11, 4 se bada hai. Zoya sahi hai ya galat?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai, kyunki 11, 4 se bada hai. Zoya sahi hai ya galat?

director.text: sahi nahi

Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, wahi poora 11 mein bata toh har gap chhota, isliye 1/11 pehle rukta hai, 1/4 se pehle; Zoya galat hai. Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
director.card: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?

director.text: first
Sahi jawab: 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne.
thak gayi, bye
Theek hai Riya, tum thak gayi ho—hum ruk sakte hain. Chuno: aage chalna, thoda pause, ya aaj ke liye band karna?
